title: They Work but I Have my Concerns
text:
They Work but I Have my Concerns. Frozen pizzas are a popular food option in my house, thanks to our busy schedules and the desire to make food that is quick and requires little or no prep. We need something to help get the pizza out of the oven and cut/serve and this need convinced me to get the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula.

Sold as a pair, the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula is good for scooping a pizza from the oven and serving it on the table or counter. The boards have an extended handle and even have a slot so that you can hang them on a hook. The beveled edge helps make it easy to get the paddle underneath a pizza, lift, and remove from the oven. Once removed, the paddles double as a cutting board and serving plate.

I like these boards and have found them useful, but I do have concerns. For one, the moment they arrived, they already had small nicks in the edge of both paddles. The nick is too small to matter now, but given that these are made of wood and can so easily get a blemish like this, it makes me wonder how long until the same thing happens again and possible splinters start to show.

Another issue I have is with the size and thickness. The boards are a little thinner than I prefer and the size, well, it isn’t that big. It can handle only a small, store- bought pizza but that’s it. Anything larger will extend over the sides of the pan. However, besides pizza, you could also use these paddle pans for other things, like for serving meat and cheese. The handles make it easy to pick them up and transport from place to place with one hand.

We like to eat pizza and the HOMEFAVOR Pizza Paddle Spatula is a good addition to our kitchen. I am concerned about the nicks, the small size, and I am also a little concerned about excessive washing taking its toll. So, overall, this is a good item but it may not be adequate for some people.
